sentences.text: Researchers used a worm model to investigate how the bacterium Comamonas aquatica protects motor neurons from degeneration caused by high levels of the TIR-1/SARM1 protein.
Feeding the worms this bacterium reduced nerve damage by supplying vitamin B12, which lowered harmful homocysteine levels in their intestines.
The authors suggest these findings help explain how gut bacteria might protect against human neurodegenerative diseases, though the study was conducted in animals.
